idea: 极端共振条件触发机制：仅在'高效率+强上修'双头信号同时满足时建立1.4倍多头暴露，在'低效率+强下修'双底信号时建立1.2倍空头暴露，其余情况空仓，形成高置信度的双面博弈结构。
expression_list: trade_when(and(greater(group_rank(divide(anl69_eps_best_eeps_cur_yr, anl69_ebitda_best_eeps_cur_yr), industry), 0.8), greater(ts_rank(ts_delta(anl69_eps_best_eeps_cur_yr, 5), 20), 0.8)), multiply(group_zscore(divide(anl69_eps_best_eeps_cur_yr, anl69_ebitda_best_eeps_cur_yr), industry), 1.4), trade_when(and(less(group_rank(divide(anl69_eps_best_eeps_cur_yr, anl69_ebitda_best_eeps_cur_yr), industry), 0.2), less(ts_rank(ts_delta(anl69_eps_best_eeps_cur_yr, 5), 20), 0.2)), multiply(group_zscore(divide(anl69_eps_best_eeps_cur_yr, anl69_ebitda_best_eeps_cur_yr), industry), -1.2), 0))

trade_when(and(greater(group_rank(divide(anl69_aeps_best_eeps_cur_yr, anl69_ebitda_best_eeps_cur_yr), industry), 0.8), greater(ts_rank(ts_delta(anl69_aeps_best_eeps_cur_yr, 5), 20), 0.8)), multiply(group_zscore(divide(anl69_aeps_best_eeps_cur_yr, anl69_ebitda_best_eeps_cur_yr), industry), 1.4), trade_when(and(less(group_rank(divide(anl69_aeps_best_eeps_cur_yr, anl69_ebitda_best_eeps_cur_yr), industry), 0.2), less(ts_rank(ts_delta(anl69_aeps_best_eeps_cur_yr, 5), 20), 0.2)), multiply(group_zscore(divide(anl69_aeps_best_eeps_cur_yr, anl69_ebitda_best_eeps_cur_yr), industry), -1.2), 0))
